text:
alex: Quick sync — token-cost attribution + latency breakdowns. Want to lock owners & deps before sprint planning. High level: finalize event schema, unblock ingestion backlog, add per-token latency probe. pinging eng-ml / eng-runtime / analytics

maria: Who owns the event schema and what's the target deadline?

keith: I can take ingestion backlog fixes (eng-infra). Plan: clear the two blocking ETL bugs and restart streams by EOW.

sophia: I can own the schema with priya. Proposed draft by Tue COB. Suggested fields: event_type, request_id, model, seq_len, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, cost_units. Also include environment and route id.

priya: SGTM. Add `cache_hit` (bool) and `batch_id` (nullable string). Also need separate shape for streaming vs non-streaming (streaming will emit partial events).

jordan: From runtime side — want `latency_breakdown` object: `{queue_ms, compute_ms, kv_cache_ms}` so analytics can attribute token time. Also we'll emit `model_variant` for quantized vs fp.

alex: Example schema snippet (not final):
```json
{
  "event_type": "inference_complete",
  "request_id": "r_123",
  "model": "redwood-7b-q4",
  "model_variant": "q4_0",
  "seq_len": 128,
  "tokens_in": 12,
  "tokens_out": 64,
  "latency_ms": 210,
  "latency_breakdown": {"queue_ms": 30, "compute_ms": 170, "kv_cache_ms": 10},
  "cost_units": 0.0042,
  "cache_hit": false,
  "batch_id": null
}
```

engbot: Deploy note: feature-flag `token-instr` scheduled for canary on Wed 10:00 PT. Auto-rollback at 15% error increase.

maria: Analytics needs a sample dataset + mapping doc by Wed to wire dashboards. I can create the workspace but need a sample export.

keith: I'll produce a small sample stream (one hour of synthetic events) by Tue morning.

sophia: Ran a quick smoke on 5k events — numbers look OK but queue_ms missing on a few; likely from old SDK clients. We should default to `null` and surface a flag `client_version` for filtering.

priya: Agree. Also add `is_streaming` boolean and for streaming events include `chunk_index`.

jordan: One more runtime dependency: we need a small tracer hook to capture per-layer compute time for a future perf study. Not blocking initial rollout, but want to land a noop hook now.

alex: Summarizing owners & milestones:
- Schema draft: sophia + priya -> Tue COB
- Ingestion fixes + sample stream: keith -> Fri EOD (sample by Tue morning)
- Runtime hooks + latency_breakdown: jordan -> Thu
- Analytics workspace + dashboards: maria -> Wed (needs sample)
- Canary flag: engbot notes Wed 10:00 PT

maria: I left a CR: github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/87 — needs review from keith + jordan (minor docs + schema JSON).

keith: I'll review today.

sophia: Small ask: include `tokenizer` field (name + version) so cost attribution can normalize token counts across libs.

alex: Good call. Add `tokenizer` to the schema. Also we should add a single integration test that validates event -> bq table mapping and that `latency_ms == sum(latency_breakdown)` for sanity.

priya: I'll add the integration test stub to the repo once schema is stable.

alex: Blockers? Anyone needs help unblocking dependencies?

maria: None currently. I will schedule the Friday check-in at 11:00 PT to confirm rollout readiness.

engbot: Reminder: weekly infra maintenance Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC — may affect end-to-end tests.

alex: Perfect. Let's keep async updates here. If anyone hits >1 day blocker, @alex and @maria please escalate in #eng-platform-alerts. :white_check_mark:
